method.agreement: Keep a current positive only if the second response on exactly the same native input is at or above .5.
method.current: Use the first six source-ordered current responses at or above .5.
method.generation: Replace only the original edited-position sentence. Attempt one rewrite per model. Require completed output, unchanged 4-sentence scope, and a valid non-copy rewrite.
method.human: Use a pre-2020 revision pair with the same three surrounding sentences in the selected excerpt. Both versions are ordinary writing controls. The edited focus is the complete changed sentence.
method.second: Use the first six source-ordered second responses at or above .5.
method.useful: Use .30 non-whitespace character IoU between a selected full context and the exact replaced sentence. Also count exact focus selection separately, and distinguish wrong locations from unflagged positives.
method.validation: No fitted point. Report both versions and paired flips separately. A default-policy transfer would need both generator families, no loss of useful positives and cleared human source groups in at least two publisher communities.

publisher_controls.method: Confirmation-role eLife v301 inputs, previously unscored. Select four of the retained five paragraphs around the target, keeping both adjacent paragraphs. Measure exact current and second native contexts at the already fixed .5 point. Agreement keeps current responses when the same input is positive in the second check. Human cases only; report original, constructed copyedit and paragraph splice separately.

third_generator.method: Add one frozen OLMo rewrite attempt per original revision target after the initial TinyLlama failures. Retain the completed initial study and every target. Use the same generation admission and exact-window comparison. This measures another family on the same known sources and supplies no fresh publisher replication.
third_generator.prompt:
Rewrite this sentence in different words, preserving all facts, names and numbers. Return only one complete replacement sentence between {minimum} and {maximum} words. Use no labels, quotations or extra lines.

{sentence}
